title: Redis 8.8.3
body:
### Security fixes

* [Fix ACL key permissions not being rechecked at EXEC time #15673](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/15673) Commands queued in a transaction could still access keys whose ACL permissions were revoked before the transaction was executed
* [Make an unauthenticated cluster bus port an explicit choice #15722](https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/15722) The cluster bus protocol has no authentication of its own unless `tls-cluster` is enabled, so any host able to reach a node's bus port could join the cluster and threaten it. A cluster node now warns at startup when its bus port is left unauthenticated, and the new `cluster-bus-port-protected-mode` option (default `no`) makes refusing to run in that state an explicit choice: set it to `yes` and the node starts only when `tls-cluster` authenticates the bus
* TimeSeries: Prevented Redis from crashing when adding samples to a compressed Time Series key restored from a malformed RDB payload
* Vector Sets: Deeply nested JSON used in Vector Set queries could cause the server to crash





<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **High Risk**
> Security release changes ACL enforcement on MULTI/EXEC, cluster networking policy, and server crash paths—areas that affect authorization and cluster integrity if misconfigured or regressed.
> 
> **Overview**
> **Redis 8.8.3** is a security-focused release: version bump, release notes, and test/CI defaults so cluster workflows can still start without TLS on the bus.
> 
> **ACL at `EXEC`:** Queued commands are re-checked against the **queued** command’s keys (via `pendingCommand`), not `EXEC`’s argv—so revoking key patterns after `MULTI` blocks access as intended. `getClientCachedKeyResult` and `ACLCheckAllPerm` are tied to the specific pending command to avoid mixing cache with the wrong command.
> 
> **Cluster bus:** New **`cluster-bus-port-protected-mode`** (default `no`) logs when the bus is unauthenticated without `tls-cluster`; **`yes`** refuses startup or incompatible `CONFIG SET` unless TLS protects the bus or protection is waived. Documentation in `TLS.md` / `redis.conf` clarifies that `tls-auth-clients` does not weaken the bus.
> 
> **Vector Sets:** The fastjson parser caps nested-array recursion at **1000** levels to avoid stack overflow on malicious JSON; tests cover depth limits.
> 
> **Module command filters:** When filters change argv, the server re-runs **`preprocessCommand`** so slot/cross-slot/ACL key state stays consistent.
>
